rules.statement: A party's acceptance of a late payment constitutes a waiver of the right to forfeit in future due to similar non-payment.
rules.supporting_quote: "The respondent accepts the April rent though late and warns the appellant that if it happens again, he will take appropriate action, meaning thereby, that he will take action upon a forfeiture in terms of the settlement. It is clear to my mind that the respondent by this statement conveyed to the appellant his decision not to take advantage of the default as was his right under the settlement. He was excusing him this time but warned that he would not do so in case of default in the future."
